prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: one APPROVAL-ONLY Rakky Ride RIDE SELECTION page mockup, tall portrait mobile screenshot proportion390×844 logical pixels, about9:19.5 aspect, no physical phone frame, no perspective, no comparison board.
Input1 is an ACTUAL public Google Maps screenshot crop to reuse as background reference. Scale/crop these real map pixels; do not invent streets, illustrated maps or fake route geometry. No private location data is present. Actual app keeps its existing live map, route and markers; this picture is an overlay proposal.
Input2 is the approved destination-page visual reference for white rounded sheets, restrained green outlines and compact typography. Use its calm style, but this page is RIDE SELECTION, not address entry.
Primary request: keep the map in the background, replace all awkward car/seat/payment glyphs with professional conventional icons, compact every element, very small typography. All headings15px maximum at390 logical width, body13–14px, supporting text12–13px, button14px. Do NOT create oversized heavy titles. Utility icon glyphs16–18px with comfortable44–48px touch targets. Car symbol42px wide maximum. Refined and readable.
Top overlay: one floating white route-summary bar with16px radius, about72px height, inset16px, top safe area. Small20px back arrow left (not a close X), two compact route lines in the middle with tiny pickup circle and destination pin: sample "Current location" and "Ikeja City Mall". A small18px pencil/edit button at right. No add-stop plus; that control has no supported action in the current app. No long single-line run-on route. Do not add a menu, sun toggle or avatar.
Real map remains clearly visible behind overlays through roughly the TOP58% of the screen. At the map bottom show provider Google logo and "Map data ©2026 Google" clearly above the bottom sheet. No claimed driver ETA, fake driver vehicles or hand-painted route. Existing runtime route will still be displayed by Google Maps when implemented.
Lower white sheet begins around58%, rounds top corners24px, small silver drag handle. Compact16px horizontal padding, no large empty filler region.
Header "Choose your ride" in15px semibold, then in12px muted "Arrival time appears after a driver accepts".
ONLY ONE supported ride option: a compact selected card with thin green border and pale mint fill, about100px high. At left a STANDARD GENERIC CAR ICON: crisp conventional side-profile sedan outline/silhouette in forest green/charcoal,42px wide, two simple wheels. NOT emoji, NOT a toy car, NOT a 3D illustration, NOT a luxury brand or huge picture. Center text "Ride" in14px medium, small PERSON OUTLINE and "4 seats" in12px (not a pawn/chess piece), and short "Everyday rides" in12px muted. At right sample "₦3,500" in14px semibold with "Quoted fare" in12px. Selection expressed with thin green border and a small check-circle icon, no large Recommended badge. Bottom of card a quiet "View ride details" link in12px with tiny chevron, using the existing ride-details action. Ensure no overlaps and no extra ride types or promotional claims.
Below card a neat payment row, small18px BANKNOTE OUTLINE icon, primary "Cash" in14px, secondary "Pay after your trip" in12px, small16px downward chevron at right to open existing payment chooser. No abstract square or bullseye symbol.
Bottom full-width48px rounded12px forest-green action with14px label exactly "Request Ride · ₦3,500". This opens the existing confirmation step; no booking is actually made by this image. Subtle bottom safe area. Do not add a new second CTA, fake discounts, wallet balance, price guarantee, distance, time or insurance claim.
Colors: white #FFFFFF, silver #EEF1EC, forest green #176B17, charcoal #141A14, muted #586253, mint #EAF5E5. Inter-style compact typography, restrained shadows, clean thin outlines. No excessive borders, oversized typography, gradients or giant art. Fit the sheet to the real content so the map has more room.
Small caption OUTSIDE the phone UI: "Ride selection • Design proposal • Sample fare".

Use case: ui-mockup. Refine ONLY this Rakky Ride ride-selection design. Preserve its two-line route summary, actual public map backdrop, one Ride option, sample price, cash row, View ride details link, and Request Ride action. Keep the standard side-profile sedan style rather than emoji or3D.
The user explicitly wants VERY COMPACT icons and typography. At390px logical width (this image is roughly865px wide):
- Reduce the green car silhouette to42px logical width (around90 actual image pixels), HALF its current size. Keep its proportions and generic sedan shape.
- Reduce the selected card to about100–110 logical pixels high, with tighter padding. The View ride details link remains a small32px subrow.
- Reduce the check-circle to18px logical and the cash banknote icon to18px logical. Ordinary utility icons16–18px.
- Make Choose your ride15px logical maximum, not a large display heading. Ride name and price14px, secondary text12–13px, button14px. Route addresses remain13px. Do not enlarge text to fill space.
- Reduce cash row to56px logical high; button48px high.
- Eliminate the huge gaps between payment row and button and below button. Use consistent12px gaps plus16px bottom safe area.
Use the space saved to let the actual map occupy approximatelyTOP55–58% of the full screen, moving the rounded bottom sheet down. Keep tall390×844 screenshot proportions. No large blank region inside the sheet.
REMOVE the floating map crosshair/recenter button completely: it is not currently on this ride-selection page. Do not add new controls or functions. Keep map attribution visible above sheet. No invented driver ETA, no new ride classes, no discounts. All actual live route and payment/confirmation behavior will remain unchanged if user approves. This is approval-only, not implementation.
